The insurance coverage for your property located at **1982 Helena Way, Brentwood, CA 94513** is provided under a homeowners insurance policy with **QBE Insurance Corporation**, serviced by **Millennial Specialty Insurance**.

### Policy Details
*   **Policy Number:** QWB86640732
*   **Policy Period:** 7/24/2025 to 7/24/2026
*   **Total Premium:** $860.15 for 12 months
*   **Named Insured(s):** Parag Agarwal & Shubhra Bhushan
*   **Agent:** American Home Insurance Agency, Inc. (Phone: (855) 424-4467)
*   **Claims/Customer Service:** (844) 994-4601

### Key Coverage Notes
*   **Exclusions:** The policy does not provide coverage for water damage caused by flood. Earthquake coverage is only provided if it is listed under the "Endorsements/Forms" section with an associated premium charge.
*   **Ordinance/Law Coverage:** The policy includes coverage for ordinance or law, up to 10.00% of the Coverage A limit of liability.
*   **Coverage A:** The limit of liability for the structure (Coverage A) is based on a replacement cost estimate of $550,000.
*   **Wildfire Risk:** Your policy premium reflects a wildfire risk classification based on a FireLine® Wildfire Hazard Score of 9.

### Billing Information
*   **Payment Due Date:** 07/24/2025
*   **Payment Instructions:** Payments can be made through the customer portal at [www.msimga.com](http://www.msimga.com) or by calling customer service at (844) 994-4601. Checks should be made payable to Millennial Specialty Insurance and sent to P.O. Box 210788, Bedford, TX 76095.

For detailed policy documents, billing statements, and account management, you can access your account via the customer portal at [www.msimga.com](http://www.msimga.com) using your registered email (agarwal.parag@gmail.com).
